def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Split panels at the all-zero divider. Their shared color is the canvas;

    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == 0 for row in grid))

    return [[3 if left[r][c] == color and right[r][c] == color else color

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1 and all(row[c] not in (4, 8) for row in grid))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    common = set(v for row in left for v in row) & set(v for row in right for v in row)
    bg = max(common, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in left for x in row))
    n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == bg and right[r][c] == bg else bg for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
